purpose: 老师反馈：主题含义可并存，明确连续权重、主导分类与探索性多标签的区别。
threshold_definition: topic_present_k = 1 if the frozen normalized NMF weight w_k >= threshold; else 0
threshold_selection: Exploratory, outcome-independent convenience thresholds; 0.20=1/5. Chosen after the original analysis; not preregistered or semantically validated.

original_continuous_model.coefficient_interpretation: A 0.10 rise of w_k replacing 0.10 of reference-topic weight with all other weights and covariates fixed; 100*(exp(0.10*theta_k)-1) is the conditional geometric-mean change in likes+1.
original_continuous_model.why_omit_one_weight: Five normalized weights sum to one, so five weights plus intercept are exactly collinear. This compositional constraint does not imply mutually exclusive semantics.

multilabel_model.formula: log_likes ~ log_length + self_discipline + social_address + positive_expression + question + has_tag + emoji_count + course_ref + C(contentTypeStr) + C(type) + C(time_bin) + C(author) + C(date) + topic_present_0 + topic_present_1 + topic_present_2 + topic_present_3 + topic_present_4
multilabel_model.no_reference_topic: All five binary indicators enter together; their row sums vary. Full-rank checks, rather than k-1 dummy coding, determine estimability.
multilabel_model.coefficient_interpretation: Conditional 0-to-1 indicator contrast with other four indicators and covariates held fixed; not a contrast to a single reference topic and not a causal effect.
multilabel_model.uncertainty: Author-clustered t inference, finite-sample correction, 95% individual intervals; BH correction across five topic coefficients at each threshold. Uncertainty from NMF estimation and threshold choice is not included.
multilabel_model.multiple_thresholds: Threshold results are sensitivity diagnostics. No significance search or selection among thresholds; five-term BH is per specification, not across the full family of sensitivity models.
multilabel_model.no_all_zero_group: At thresholds 0.15, 0.20, 0.25, every assigned post has at least one label; coefficients are conditional contrasts, not comparisons to an observed no-topic group.

scope: All proportions use the 2,470 assigned-text posts, not all 9,532 posts. The original eight near-zero-contribution documents and all other ineligible posts remain unassigned, rather than being coded as five observed zeros.
